parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description:
The language of the content in the request and response. Default value: **zh**. Valid values:

*   **zh**: Chinese.
*   **en**: English.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun sas list-oss-bucket --bucket-name iboxpublic0000 --lang en --api-version 2018-12-03 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun sas ListOssBucket --region cn-hangzhou --BucketName iboxpublic0000 --Lang en
